text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, Ayabe? Could we ask you to come
along on
our upcoming stargazing
session?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For our independent research
assignment, we
made our theme "reach
for the stars" and decided
to try some
amateur astronomy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Surely you can find someone more
suitable than
me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, Curren told us, "Ayabe knows
more about
stars than anyone else at this
school!" So
obviously you're the real
deal!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I wish she would stop that... Look, it's
just such
short notice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm sorry! We're so inconsiderate...
All we
could think about was how fun
it'd be. Of course
you can't...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I meant... I need to hurry and plan.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want to hear any
complaining. And
don't make a racket
out there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, okay! We'll make sure not to
bother the
neighborhood!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Good. I'll let you know when I figure
out what
day's clear enough for it.
